note: Ground truth for the live radar eval. Queries are hand-written the way a reporter would type them, never copied from a seeded summary. `expected` holds real Jira keys of the seeded corpus issues that describe the SAME failure as the query (near-miss and unrelated seeds are deliberately absent). A pair counts as a hit when any expected key appears in the radar comment's top-3. Controls must produce no radar comment at all.

pairs.summary: Checkout falls over at peak again
pairs.description: Every evening around seven the payment page hangs for about a minute; the connection pool looks saturated again.
pairs.why: Pool exhaustion under load: same failure as the checkout latency/timeout seeds.

pairs.summary: Customers see 504s when traffic is high
pairs.description: The gateway returns 504 for a slice of calls during the sale; the payment step is the worst hit.
pairs.why: Gateway timeouts caused by the same saturated backend.

pairs.summary: Cart requests queue up at rush hour
pairs.description: Nothing errors, everything is just slow: orders wait in line behind a saturated backend and the cart page spins.
pairs.why: Queueing/db-connection saturation, no explicit error code.

pairs.summary: Payment errors started right after today's release
pairs.description: 5xx on the charge endpoint jumped within minutes of the new version going live; about one payment in ten fails.
pairs.why: Bad release regression on the payment path.

pairs.summary: Customers got charged twice for one order
pairs.description: Duplicate charges reported since last night's build shipped; support is fielding refunds.
pairs.why: Same post-release regression, visible as duplicate charges.

pairs.summary: We rolled the release back, checkout was broken
pairs.description: The morning build broke the checkout submit path; rollback fixed it within minutes. Has this happened before?
pairs.why: Rollback of a broken build; the deploy seeds name the same regression.

pairs.summary: Database server is out of space
pairs.description: Writes are failing on prod-db-2 and df shows the data partition at 100%.
pairs.why: Disk exhausted on the database host.

pairs.summary: A log file grew until the node filled up
pairs.description: Debug logging was left on and ate 90 GB; the server ran out of room and services degraded.
pairs.why: Log-driven disk exhaustion; same failure, different cause.

pairs.summary: Integration calls rejected with 401 this morning
pairs.description: All our API requests come back 401 Unauthorized; the access token is past its expiry date.
pairs.why: Expired credential causing 401s on integration jobs.

pairs.summary: Nightly sync has not run since the credential lapsed
pairs.description: No records since last week; the refresh token expired and the job fails on its first call.
pairs.why: Refresh token expiry stopping a scheduled job.

controls.summary: App icon looks blurry on the iPad launcher
controls.description: The launcher icon renders soft at 2x; design wants it crisp on the home grid.
controls.why: Cosmetic UI issue, no operational failure family.

controls.summary: Accessibility audit flags missing alt text on the settings page
controls.description: Automated audit reports unlabelled images in the settings tab.
controls.why: Compliance/UI debt, unrelated to any seeded incident.

controls.summary: Weekly retro notes are missing from Confluence
controls.description: Last week's retro page never got created; the team cannot find the notes.
